protocol:
1.  Aspirate a liquid sample from a microcentrifuge tube using a micropipette while keeping the tube over a green ice bucket.
2.  Dispense the liquid sample from the micropipette into a well of an E-Gel EX pre-cast agarose gel cassette.
3.  Repeat the loading process by pipetting additional samples into the subsequent wells of the E-Gel cassette.
4.  Place the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap Electrophoresis System.
5.  Close the lid of the E-Gel Power Snap Electrophoresis System.
6.  Select a program and initiate the electrophoresis run using the touchscreen on the E-Gel Power Snap device.
